items.quote: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
items.claim: The text (Exodus 10:22) says Moses stretched his hand toward heaven and a thick darkness covered all of Egypt for three days. This is the narrative's own account and has not been checked against outside historical sources.
items.action: stretched forth his hand toward heaven
items.object: thick darkness over the land of Egypt
items.mechanism: The narrative ties the darkness to Moses' gesture toward heaven

items.quote: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days:
items.claim: The text (Exodus 10:23) says that during the darkness people in Egypt could not see one another, and no one got up from their place for three days.
items.action: saw not one another, neither rose from their place
items.mechanism: The thick darkness stopped them from seeing or moving

items.quote: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.
items.claim: The text (Exodus 10:23) says that, unlike the rest of Egypt, all the Israelites had light in their homes during the darkness.
items.mechanism: The narrative presents the Israelites as exempt from the darkness
